author: Stahly
description:
The Necromunda Skirmish Core Set hit shelves this weekend, kicking off a fresh edition of gang warfare in the depths of Hive Primus. To mark the occasion, we've dug through our archives for five of our favourite Necromunda posts: gang showcases, diorama builds, and of course our take on the brand-new Core Set itself. Time to load your autoguns and get reacquainted with the underhive.

The post Top 5 Necromunda miniature showcases you can’t miss appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Top 5 Necromunda miniature showcases you can’t miss
